ucs.title: [LLM] Salt Typhoon (Earth Estries) GhostSpider/SnappyBee DLL sideloading via signed Notepad++/MSDTC/.NET hosts with external TLS C2
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Salt Typhoon (a.k.a. Earth Estries / GhostEmperor / FamousSparrow, CrowdStrike: not yet a public 'Panda' but tracked as ChinaNexus telecom intrusion set) DLL-sideloading chain: a legitimate signed binary (GUP.exe, MSDTC, mscorsvw, mscoree, etc.) is dropped to a user-writable path together with a hijacked DLL, loaded by the host, and the host process subsequently beacons over TLS to the actor's tiered infrastructure. This combination — signed-binary-from-writable-path + non-System32 DLL load + outbound 443/8443 within an hour — is the documented Demodex/SnappyBee/GhostSpider
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_path) as proc_path from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("gup.exe","GUP.exe","msdtc.exe","MSDTC.exe","mscorsvw.exe","mscoree.exe","appcmd.exe","wmiprvse.exe","searchindexer.exe") AND (Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\PerfLogs\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*") NOT (Processes.process_path="*\\Program Files\\*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_id host | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=inner dest [ | tstats summariesonly=true count values(All_Traffic.dest) as remote_ip values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as remote_port from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_port IN (443,8443,8080) NOT (All_Traffic.dest_category="internal" OR All_Traffic.dest="10.0.0.0/8" OR All_Traffic.dest="192.168.0.0/16" OR All_Traffic.dest="172.16.0.0/12") by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.app | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | rename src as dest ] | where lastTime - firstTime < 3600 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | table firstTime lastTime dest user process_name proc_path cmdline remote_ip remote_port
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let SideloadHosts = dynamic(["gup.exe","msdtc.exe","mscorsvw.exe","appcmd.exe","wmiprvse.exe","mscoree.exe","searchindexer.exe"]);
let SuspiciousPaths = dynamic([@"\ProgramData\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\PerfLogs\"]);
let Sideloads = DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (SideloadHosts)
    | where FileName endswith ".dll"
    | where FolderPath has_any (SuspiciousPaths)
    | where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Windows\System32\"
        and FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Windows\SysWOW64\"
        and FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files"
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"     // exclude machine accounts
    | project SideloadTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              SideloaderProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              SideloaderPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              SideloaderPid = InitiatingProcessId,
              SideloadedDll = FileName,
              SideloadedDllPath = FolderPath,
              InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where RemotePort in (443, 8443, 8080)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (SideloadHosts)
| join kind=inner Sideloads on DeviceId, $left.InitiatingProcessId == $right.SideloaderPid
| where Timestamp between (SideloadTime .. SideloadTime + 1h)     // 1h = post-load beacon window
| summarize FirstBeacon = min(Timestamp), BeaconCount = count(),
            RemoteIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 25), RemoteUrls = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25)
            by DeviceName, SideloaderProcess, SideloaderPath, SideloadedDll, SideloadedDllPath, InitiatingProcessAccountName
| order by FirstBeacon desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let SideloadHosts = dynamic(["gup.exe","msdtc.exe","mscorsvw.exe","appcmd.exe","wmiprvse.exe","mscoree.exe","searchindexer.exe"]);
let SuspiciousPaths = dynamic([@"\ProgramData\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\PerfLogs\"]);
let SuspiciousLaunches = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where TargetProcessName has_any (SideloadHosts)
    | where TargetProcessName has_any (SuspiciousPaths)
          and not (TargetProcessName has @"\Program Files")
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | project StartTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessId,
              ActingProcessCommandLine, ActorUsername;
ImNetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where DstPortNumber in (443, 8443, 8080)
| where ipv4_is_private(DstIpAddr) == false
| join kind=inner SuspiciousLaunches on $left.DvcHostname == $right.DvcHostname
| where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. StartTime + 1h)
| summarize FirstBeacon = min(TimeGenerated), BeaconCount = count(),
            RemoteIPs = make_set(DstIpAddr, 25)
            by DvcHostname, TargetProcessName, ActorUsername, ActingProcessCommandLine
| order by FirstBeacon desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Salt Typhoon — Signed Sideload Host Executed From Writable Path
id: 8f3a2d2a-9d6a-4a7c-9a64-3c4f3c1b1c10
status: experimental
description: Detects Salt Typhoon / Earth Estries DLL-sideloading staging — a legitimately-signed loader binary (GUP.exe, MSDTC, mscorsvw, mscoree, etc.) executed from a user-writable directory rather than its expected install location. This is the canonical Demodex / GhostSpider / SnappyBee deployment pattern.
references:
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/24/k/earth-estries.html
  - https://www.sygnia.co/blog/ghost-emperor-demodex-rootkit/
author: detection engineering
date: 2026/06/10
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1218
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_host:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\gup.exe'
      - '\msdtc.exe'
      - '\mscorsvw.exe'
      - '\mscoree.exe'
      - '\appcmd.exe'
      - '\wmiprvse.exe'
      - '\searchindexer.exe'
  selection_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
      - '\PerfLogs\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
  filter_legit_install:
    Image|contains: '\Program Files'
  condition: selection_host and selection_path and not filter_legit_install
falsepositives:
  - Internal IT staging that copies signed Microsoft binaries into ProgramData for repackaging.
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\gup.exe OR *\\GUP.exe OR *\\msdtc.exe OR *\\MSDTC.exe OR *\\mscorsvw.exe OR *\\MSCORSVW.exe OR *\\appcmd.exe OR *\\APPCMD.exe OR *\\wmiprvse.exe OR *\\WmiPrvSE.exe OR *\\mscoree.exe OR *\\MSCOREE.exe OR *\\searchindexer.exe OR *\\SearchIndexer.exe) @Image:(*\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\programdata\\* OR *\\PROGRAMDATA\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *\\PerfLogs\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*) -@Image:(*\\Program Files\\* OR *\\Program Files (x86)\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(gup|msdtc|mscorsvw|mscoree|appcmd|wmiprvse|searchindexer)\.exe$/i
| regex("\\\\(ProgramData|Users\\\\Public|Windows\\\\Temp|PerfLogs|AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp)\\\\", field=ImageFileName)
| NOT regex("\\\\Program Files", field=ImageFileName)
| join({#event_simpleName=NetworkConnectIP4 RemotePort=/^(443|8443|8080)$/ | NOT cidr("10.0.0.0/8", field=RemoteAddressIP4) | NOT cidr("192.168.0.0/16", field=RemoteAddressIP4) | NOT cidr("172.16.0.0/12", field=RemoteAddressIP4)}, field=[aid, TargetProcessId], include=[RemoteAddressIP4, RemotePort])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, RemoteAddressIP4, RemotePort], function=[count(), min(_time, as=FirstSeen), max(_time, as=LastSeen)])
ucs.rationale: Generic DLL-sideload hunts fire on every signed-installer build artifact. Salt Typhoon's signature is the precise pairing — a small, fixed set of Microsoft/.NET/Notepad++ loaders (documented across Trend Micro's Earth Estries write-ups and Sygnia's GhostEmperor/Demodex report) dropped to ProgramData/Public/Temp/PerfLogs with a malicious DLL of the same base name, immediately followed by tiered TLS

ucs.title: [LLM] Salt Typhoon LSASS credential extraction + packet-capture deployment on telecom / network-engineering hosts (lawful-intercept targeting)
ucs.description: Hunts Salt Typhoon's hallmark post-exploitation play documented in the 2024 US telecom intrusions (T-Mobile, AT&T, Verizon, Lumen) and the parallel Earth Estries APAC government campaigns: dump LSASS for service-account creds, then deploy native Windows packet capture (pktmon / NetEventCapture / netsh trace) on engineering jump hosts to siphon traffic — including lawful-intercept and CALEA-adjacent metadata. The combination of LSASS handle access + pktmon/NetEventSession start within a 24h window on the same host, by a non-machine account, is highly specific to this actor's signals-collection
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstLsass max(_time) as lastLsass values(Processes.process) as lsass_cmd values(Processes.user) as lsass_user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*lsass*" AND (Processes.process="*MiniDump*" OR Processes.process="*comsvcs.dll*" OR Processes.process="*procdump*" OR Processes.process="*nanodump*" OR Processes.process="*rundll32*lsass*")) NOT Processes.user="*$" by Processes.dest Processes.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=inner dest [ | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstPcap max(_time) as lastPcap values(Processes.process) as pcap_cmd values(Processes.process_name) as pcap_tool from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("pktmon.exe","tcpdump","tshark.exe","dumpcap.exe","windump.exe","rawcap.exe") OR Processes.process="*pktmon start*" OR Processes.process="*New-NetEventSession*" OR Processes.process="*NetEventCapture*" OR Processes.process="*netsh*trace*start*capture*") NOT Processes.user="*$" by Processes.dest Processes.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` ] | eval delta_h = abs(firstPcap - firstLsass)/3600 | where delta_h <= 24 | convert ctime(firstLsass) ctime(firstPcap) | table dest user firstLsass lsass_cmd firstPcap pcap_tool pcap_cmd delta_h
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 48h;
let LsassAccess = DeviceEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ActionType in ("OpenProcessApiCall","ReadProcessMemoryApiCall")
    | where AdditionalFields has "lsass.exe"
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"     // exclude machine accounts
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("MsMpEng.exe","SenseCncProxy.exe","MsSense.exe","csrss.exe","wmiprvse.exe")
    | summarize LsassTime = min(Timestamp), 
                LsassActor = any(InitiatingProcessFileName),
                LsassCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine)
                by DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName;
let PacketCapture = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where (FileName in~ ("pktmon.exe","tcpdump","tshark.exe","dumpcap.exe","windump.exe","rawcap.exe"))
         or (FileName =~ "powershell.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("New-NetEventSession","NetEventCapture","Add-NetEventPacketCaptureProvider"))
         or (FileName =~ "netsh.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "trace start" and ProcessCommandLine has "capture")
         or (FileName =~ "pktmon.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "start")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project PcapTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              PcapTool = FileName, PcapCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              PcapAccount = AccountName;
LsassAccess
| join kind=inner PacketCapture on DeviceId
| where datetime_diff('hour', PcapTime, LsassTime) between (-24 .. 24)
| project DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          LsassTime, LsassActor, LsassCmd,
          PcapTime, PcapTool, PcapCmd, PcapAccount,
          DeltaHours = datetime_diff('hour', PcapTime, LsassTime)
| order by LsassTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 48h;
let LsassDump = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where CommandLine has "lsass"
          and (CommandLine has_any ("MiniDump","comsvcs.dll","procdump","nanodump","sqldumper")
               or (NewProcessName endswith "rundll32.exe" and CommandLine has "MiniDump"))
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project LsassTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, LsassCmd = CommandLine, LsassTool = NewProcessName;
let PacketCapture = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where (NewProcessName endswith "pktmon.exe" and CommandLine has "start")
         or NewProcessName endswith_cs "tshark.exe"
         or NewProcessName endswith_cs "dumpcap.exe"
         or NewProcessName endswith_cs "windump.exe"
         or NewProcessName endswith_cs "rawcap.exe"
         or (NewProcessName endswith "netsh.exe" and CommandLine has "trace start" and CommandLine has "capture")
         or (NewProcessName endswith "powershell.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("New-NetEventSession","NetEventCapture","Add-NetEventPacketCaptureProvider"))
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project PcapTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, PcapUser = SubjectUserName, PcapCmd = CommandLine, PcapTool = NewProcessName;
LsassDump
| join kind=inner PacketCapture on Computer
| where datetime_diff('hour', PcapTime, LsassTime) between (-24 .. 24)
| project Computer, SubjectUserName, LsassTime, LsassTool, LsassCmd, PcapTime, PcapTool, PcapCmd,
          DeltaHours = datetime_diff('hour', PcapTime, LsassTime)
| order by LsassTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:4688 ((@CommandLine:(*lsass* AND (*MiniDump* OR *comsvcs.dll* OR *procdump* OR *nanodump*))) OR @Image:(*\\pktmon.exe OR *\\PktMon.exe OR *\\tshark.exe OR *\\dumpcap.exe OR *\\windump.exe OR *\\rawcap.exe) OR (@Image:(*\\netsh.exe OR *\\NETSH.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*"trace start"* AND *capture*)) OR (@Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*New-NetEventSession* OR *NetEventCapture* OR *Add-NetEventPacketCaptureProvider*))) -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (regex("lsass", field=CommandLine) AND regex("(MiniDump|comsvcs\\.dll|procdump|nanodump|sqldumper)", field=CommandLine)) OR ImageFileName=/\\(pktmon|tshark|dumpcap|windump|rawcap)\.exe$/i OR (ImageFileName=/\\netsh\.exe$/i AND regex("trace start.*capture", field=CommandLine)) OR (ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i AND regex("(New-NetEventSession|NetEventCapture|Add-NetEventPacketCaptureProvider)", field=CommandLine))
| NOT regex("\\$$", field=UserName)
| Activity := if(regex("lsass", field=CommandLine), "LsassDump", "PacketCapture")
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[collect([Activity]), min(_time, as=FirstSeen), max(_time, as=LastSeen)])
| Activity=/LsassDump/ AND Activity=/PacketCapture/
| (LastSeen - FirstSeen) <= 86400
ucs.rationale: LSASS dumping alone is noisy (red-team tooling, IR triage, Defender itself). Packet capture alone is noisy on troubleshooting hosts. The actor-specific signal is the deliberate sequencing — credential theft followed within hours by native packet-capture deployment by the SAME interactive user on the SAME host — which directly mirrors Salt Typhoon's documented telecom-intercept tradecraft.
